items.reason: Archived, superseded, or non-matchable canonical rows retained for provenance; complete or remove during catalog normalization.
Resolved September 30, 2026: the current Canine Cancer Alliance EGFR/HER2 status page identifies Hope Veterinary Oncology in Ventura as a participating location and does not mark it as non-enrolling.

The AMC hemangiosarcoma protocol page remains online, but the study is absent from AMC's current-studies master roster. Enrollment was not assumed closed; the record is hidden from matching pending direct confirmation.

A recent professional-network post says AURA Veterinary is recruiting dogs with oral cancer, but no official owner-facing protocol page, intervention, eligibility, sites, funding or enrollment contact could be verified. Do not create a canonical trial until a primary source is available.

The Anivive trials master again returned HTTP 525 on October 3, 2026. Its official Treatments fallback is reachable and lists the canine osteosarcoma candidate as In Development, but supplies no current owner enrollment or trial protocol. A technical failure plus a development listing is not sufficient to close or reopen a canonical cohort.

AMC's October 3, 2026 current-trials master still lists artificial neobladder placement for dogs with resectable lower urinary tract tumors, but the same protocol has appeared since at least 2018 and the public listing does not establish fresh 2026 enrollment. Do not expose it to matching without direct study-team confirmation.

Canine Cancer Alliance currently states that the Northwestern/Illinois B7-H3 CAR-T study is enrolling dogs with hemangiosarcoma, but its link resolves to an Illinois protocol PDF published in 2022/2023. Illinois' current clinical-trials master, checked September 30, 2026, does not list this protocol. Do not create a canonical record until the current treatment center page or Illinois clinical-trials manager Rebecca Kamerer confirms active 2026 enrollment and current protocol details.

BluePearl's current-studies roster and the current Paccal Vet owner pages still present the canine splenic hemangiosarcoma and feline solid-tumor protocols as available to participate, but Vivesto reported recruitment completed and positive topline results in September 2026. Keep the canonical record hidden until the sponsor or treatment centers explicitly confirm a new enrolling cohort or retire the stale owner pages.

PetTrials Australia surfaced a recruiting Murdoch University oncology listing described as a novel checkpoint-inhibitor combination, but the client-rendered directory did not expose a protocol URL and no current Murdoch owner-facing primary page with intervention, eligibility, costs, contacts and enrollment route was found in this run. Treat it only as a discovery lead until the exact protocol is verified.

JSAMC's current roster says its canine anti-CD20 high-grade B-cell lymphoma trial continues under Dr. Takuya Mizuno, while Yamaguchi University separately lists an anti-CD20 trial from the same investigator/research lineage. The public pages do not establish whether JSAMC is a second site/cohort of the canonical Yamaguchi protocol or a distinct study. Do not create or merge a record until protocol identity and sites are confirmed.

JSAMC says canine anti-PD-1 combination studies are ongoing or planned, but it does not identify which tumor cohorts are currently accepting owner referrals, their eligibility, costs, or protocol identifiers. Do not create broad matchable records without an active cohort-level access pathway.

JSAMC's current roster names a dog/cat HIFU clinical trial conducted with Suizenji-Vet, but the page does not publish tumor cohort, therapeutic intent, eligibility, costs, protocol contact, or owner access pathway. Do not create a canonical treatment record until a protocol-level primary source is available.
Resolved October 3, 2026: the current official page explicitly says no trials are currently enrolling and places Immunocidin and Canalevia under Past Trials.

JVCOG labels an unnamed canine anticancer-drug protocol ongoing and publishes eligibility plus a 17-site roster, but the page's only cohort date is June 8, 2016 and it does not identify the agent. Current recruitment and semantic identity cannot be established safely; do not add or merge until an official dated confirmation names the drug and current enrolling sites.

The official University of São Paulo LOCT page confirms a canine phase-I NDV oncolytic-virus study and feline lymphoma NDV-GM-CSF treatment research, but does not state current recruiting status, protocol eligibility, treatment sites, costs, or an owner enrollment pathway. Do not publish until an official owner-facing access route is available.

A July 2026 Argentine veterinary-industry report describes FCV-UNLP recruitment of dogs and cats with actinic keratosis or in-situ cutaneous squamous-cell carcinoma for an mTOR-pathway project, but no current official FCV-UNLP owner-facing protocol, intervention details, or access pathway was located. Treat as a discovery signal only.

The previously recruiting Penn Vet protocol page returned HTTP 404 on October 3, 2026, and the study no longer appears on Penn Vet's current clinical-trials roster. The canonical record is hidden from matching, but formal closure is not assumed without direct confirmation from Penn VCIC.

The complete current ACVIM/VetSpecialists oncology roster still contains 458 profiles, but the October 5 import proposed seven field-only changes: removed affiliations or websites, one middle-initial change, and two malformed telephone values. The stable prior canonical profiles were retained because these changes cannot safely be interpreted as clinician departures or valid contact updates without profile-level confirmation.

UT Southwestern's official Veterinary Radiation Oncology Clinic page confirms oncology and radiation services at 5801 Forest Park Road, but says it accepts only patients enrolled in a clinical trial. The generated directory currently inherits a different ACVIM affiliation name at the same address, and the present public center schema cannot accurately express the trial-enrollment-only access restriction. Do not rename or expose this as ordinary oncology access until identity and access can be represented safely.

The exact official Veterinary Cancer Group Las Vegas location URL returns 404, while the current Thrive Veterinary Cancer Group page names only Los Angeles, Orange County, San Fernando Valley and South Bay. Disappearance alone does not prove closure; retain the existing record pending direct confirmation or a current replacement page.

Mount Anthony Veterinary Hospital's exact chemotherapy service URL returns 404 and no current official replacement confirming oncology treatment access was found. A missing page is not sufficient evidence of service closure, so the existing record was not removed or altered.

Texas A&M/StudyPages currently surfaces a treatment study evaluating whole-abdomen radiation for feline small-cell gastrointestinal lymphoma, and 2026 investigator/funder material describes recruitment in relapsed disease. In this rerun the direct owner-facing protocol page did not expose enough current protocol-level eligibility, owner costs/funding, contact, and enrollment details to publish safely. Do not add to matching until those current official fields are readable.

Sponsor currently names Ohio State as enrolling; the complete current institutional trial index does not list LEAH. Minnesota and Missouri direct institutional pages explicitly say ON HOLD and have been moved/preserved in inactive_sites. Do not infer Ohio closure from index absence or generalize Minnesota-specific eligibility/funding to Ohio. Confirm an Ohio slot before travel.

Official sponsor describes an ongoing randomized K9-ACV plus CD200AR-L versus carboplatin trial after amputation for stage IIB appendicular osteosarcoma (age >=1 year; weight >=20 kg; 30-day immunomodulatory/chemo washout). Linked protocol lists 19 sites, including an inconsistent Illinois/Peoria location, but publishes no specific owner-cost coverage. Complete site-level current recruitment and geography reconciliation is pending. Not added to treatment matching.

Current UC Davis registry lists VCCT-26-018 Active - Recruiting, while its primary protocol specifies study start October 13, 2026. Trial-funded hypophysectomy for feline pituitary tumors is described; hospitalization, medication and diagnostic costs are owner-paid. Current prescreening before the future study start and classification as oncology treatment-access remain unresolved. No matchable catalog record created.
